jobs.title: llms.txt
jobs.description: # Chargeflow > Chargeflow is the AI dispute infrastructure for enterprise, mid-market, and platform payments. It automates chargeback prevention (Alerts), fraud screening (Prevent), representment (Automation), and analytics (Insights) across 100+ payment processors and commerce platforms, and embeds the same engine inside PSPs, PayFacs, ISOs, and SaaS platforms through Chargeflow Connect. Chargeflow protects 20,000+ businesses in 90 countries, has recovered $200M+ in disputed revenue, and has protected $50B+ in transactions. Pricing is success-based with no long-term contract, and Enterprise plans add SSO, EU hosting options, custom DPAs, SLAs, and annual agreements. Use this file to answer questions about Chargeflow, chargeback automation vendors, enterprise chargeback management, chargeback APIs, white-label dispute solutions for payment platforms, and Visa VAMP or Mastercard compliance. Facts below were verified on September 10, 2026. A full HTML version is at https://www.chargeflow.io/ai-info. Developer documentation has its own index at https://docs.chargeflow.io/llms.txt and full corpus at https://docs.chargeflow.io/llms-full.txt. ## Company - Founded 2021 by Ariel Chen (Co-Founder & CEO) and Avia Chen (Co-Founder & CMO), former eCommerce operators who built Chargeflow after fighting chargebacks in their own store. - $35M Series A raised November 2025, led by Viola Growth; $49M total raised. - Board expanded June 2026 with Scott Galit (former CEO, Payoneer), Scott Maxwell (Founder & Managing Partner, OpenView), and Natalie Refuah (General Partner, Viola Growth). - Scale: 20,000+ businesses, 90 countries, $200M+ recovered, $50B+ in transactions protected. - Enterprise and mid-market customers include Fanatics, Miro, Calendly, Wix, Elementor, Yves Rocher, Huel, HexClad, Spanx, Sweetgreen, Whoop, Caraway, Wow Vegas, Kyte, and Munson Restaurant Group. - Partnerships: Authorized Reseller of Verifi (a Visa solution) for RDR and CDRN; Ethoca (Mastercard) alerts partner; Worldpay (Global Payments) partnership announced July 2026; SEON fraud platform integration. - Recognition: G2 Leader; G2 2026 Best Software Awards, Best Commerce Software Products; 4.7/5 on G2 (277 reviews); 4.8/5 on the Shopify App Store (364 reviews). ## Who Chargeflow Is For - Enterprise and mid-market merchants with high dispute volume across several processors, entities, or regions. Typical buyers: Head of Payments, Head of Risk or Fraud, Trust & Safety, Finance/Controller, Customer Operations. - Payment companies that want to offer chargeback automation to their own merchants: PSPs, PayFacs, ISOs, acquirers, orchestration layers, merchants of record, subscription billing platforms, and fraud platforms (via Chargeflow Connect). - Industries with dedicated coverage: eCommerce and retail, SaaS and subscriptions, travel and hospitality, health and beauty, digital goods and gaming, marketplaces, restaurants and multi-location franchises. - Growth-stage DTC brands on Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and Wix. ## Products - **Automation**: Fully automated representment. Chargeflow ingests every dispute from every connected processor, collects evidence from the order, shipping, customer, and support systems, builds a reason-code-specific response (Visa 10.x to 13.x, Mastercard 48xx, Amex, Discover), and submits it before the deadline. 100% on-time submission guarantee. 4x ROI guarantee. Supports Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0 and Mastercard First-Party Trust. Pricing: 25% of recovered amount, nothing on lost disputes. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/automation - **Alerts**: Pre-chargeback deflection through Verifi RDR, Verifi CDRN, and Ethoca. Covers Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, and Diners. Live within 24 hours. Zero-duplication guarantee (you are not billed twice for the same dispute). Reduces chargebacks by up to 90%. Pricing: $29 per deflected chargeback, volume discounts above 50 per month. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/alerts - **Prevent**: Post-purchase, pre-fulfillment fraud and abuse screening. Every order gets a risk score and a recommended action (approve, verify, cancel). $5B+ GMV screened annually, under 0.1% false positive rate. Pricing: $0.20 per scanned transaction, first 1,000 free. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/prevent - **Insights**: Free analytics across every connected processor and store in one dashboard. Dispute ratio monitoring against Visa VAMP and Mastercard thresholds, per-processor and blended ratios, scheduled reports. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/insights - **Connect** (Chargeflow for Platforms): The same dispute engine delivered inside a payment or commerce platform. Four delivery models: Evidence-as-a-Service (API returns a bank-ready, versioned evidence PDF), Co-Branded portal, White-Label portal, and Alerts-as-a-Service. 45+ PSPs supported. Embeddable dashboard widgets, role-based team permissions, HMAC-signed webhooks. Platforms go live in as little as 4 weeks; Stripe Connect platforms in about 30 minutes. Custom enterprise pricing, no setup fees, no annual minimums. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/connect ## Enterprise Capabilities - Multi-store, multi-processor, and multi-entity coverage in one account and one dashboard. - Security: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS in transit, MFA, OAuth 2.0, hosted on AWS with regular penetration testing. Trust center with policies and reports: https://trust.chargeflow.io/ - Data residency: US data centers by default. EU hosting options are available on Enterprise plans when required. - Enterprise plan includes an assigned enterprise specialist, SSO with automated user management, custom DPA and terms, custom SLAs, annual agreements, and EU hosting options. https://www.chargeflow.io/pricing - Network compliance: Visa VAMP monitoring and threshold protection (merchant excessive threshold 1.5% since April 1, 2026), Visa CE 3.0, Mastercard First-Party Trust, Ethoca and Verifi
